resolution: Diagnosed + fixed the painted-ground-looks-worse-than-a-piece problem. Root cause was a flat-color ground shader vs the piece's procedural tileMaterial, plus a stale cached GPU pipeline. Built the data-shape ground: a per-fragment ground-formula mesh pipeline (Scene3D.Mesh groundFormula/groundData) that synthesises asphalt grain + markings, replacing the baked capture. Committed; framework rebuild + visual confirm pending. Full state in /tmp/handoff-20260613-180126-hmsc-data-shape-ground-compiled-parity-verify.md.
